#### `def _read_utf8_with_fallback(file, fallback_encoding)` (Línea 51)
- **Propósito:** First try to read the file with UTF-8, if there is an error fallback to a
different encoding ("locale" by default). Returns the content of the file.
Also useful when reading files that might have been produced by an older version of
setuptools.
- **Firma:** `def _read_utf8_with_fallback(file, fallback_encoding)`
- **Retorno / Efectos:** Consulta código fuente.

#### `def _cfg_read_utf8_with_fallback(cfg, file, fallback_encoding)` (Línea 67)
- **Propósito:** Same idea as :func:`_read_utf8_with_fallback`, but for the
